pictures.name: QNM1-Things-In-Light
pictures.prompt: A vast, softly glowing space like the first morning of the world: across a field of light rest many different things, a clay bowl, a cooking pot, a feather, a fig, a stone, a seashell, a sprig of leaves, each in its own small pool of gold. Wonder and order. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
